# ==============================================================================
# KhatamRouter Upstream Sync Override List
# ==============================================================================
# Files listed here are intentionally maintained differently in KhatamRouter
# than in upstream (decolua/9router). When `git merge` produces a conflict
# on any of these paths during an upstream sync, the sync automation resolves
# it deterministically by taking OUR version (`git checkout --ours -- <path>`).
#
# Rules for this file:
#   - One path per line, relative to the repository root.
#   - Exact relative paths or glob patterns (e.g. `.specify/**`).
#   - Lines starting with `#` and empty lines are ignored.
#   - Keep entries organized by rationale so maintainers know WHY each file
#     is kept on `--ours`.
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Spec-Kit Constitution & Workflow Templates
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KhatamRouter governance and agent workflow definitions. These do not exist
# upstream and must never be deleted or overwritten by an upstream sync.
.specify/**

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Sanitized OAuth Credentials (GitHub Push-Protection Guard)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Upstream commits literal public Google OAuth client credentials. KhatamRouter
# keeps them split via `[...].join("")` in JS/TS source files and redacted in
# JSON baselines so GitHub push protection never rejects a push.
open-sse/providers/shared.js
open-sse/providers/registry/antigravity.js
open-sse/providers/registry/gemini.js
open-sse/providers/registry/gemini-cli.js
tests/__baseline__/providers-baseline.json
tests/unit/antigravity-oauth-client.test.js

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Branding, Documentation, and Local Docs Configuration
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KhatamRouter-specific branding (name, URLs, logos, Next.js docs export).
gitbook/README.md
gitbook/components/LanguageSwitcher.js
gitbook/constants/docsConfig.js
gitbook/package.json

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. CI / Automation / Packaging Workflows & Policy
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KhatamRouter maintains its own GitHub Actions workflows (multi-arch Docker
# publishing to GHCR, GitHub Pages docs deployment, and custom Dependabot rules).
.github/dependabot.yml
.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml
.github/workflows/gitbook-pages.yml

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Git Ignore Customizations
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ignores KhatamRouter-specific local artifacts (e.g., gitbook/README.md).
.gitignore

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. The Upstream-Sync Automation Itself
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These files only exist in KhatamRouter. Listed defensively so a future
# upstream file of the same name can never replace the sync machinery.
.github/upstream-sync-overrides.txt
.github/UPSTREAM_SYNC.md
.github/workflows/upstream-sync.yml
scripts/upstream-sync-local.sh
scripts/upstream-sync-sanitizer.mjs
